messages:
Sophie (CS Ops): heads-up: OrchidBank token consumption dropped ~62% week-over-week after their product lead left. Procurement just messaged asking about pricing and alternatives; they mentioned a short pilot with CompetitorX. link: https://app.metrics/OrchidBank/dashboard
Ajay (CSM): yikes. do we know what parts of the product dropped? embeddings vs chat?
Sophie (CS Ops): Eng Analytics Bot pulled top routes: /generate/chat and /embed took the biggest hit. full 30d trend exported.
Eng Analytics Bot: summary: 30d tokens = 38k vs prior 30d = 100k. top endpoints by volume: /generate/chat, /embed, /rerank, /summarize, /qa. perf link: https://dashboards.internal/plots/ob-2141599999.png
Kyle (AE): I just got a note from Claire H. (procurement) asking for pilot terms and SLO details. she scheduled a procurement sync in 13 days; renewal is in 38 days. I can attend.
Maria (CS Lead): set account risk to amber. immediate action plan: 1) procurement call (Kyle) 2) product & success sync (Ajay) 3) enablement pack + quick wins (Sophie) 4) short pilot credit/discount option (Maria).
Ajay (CSM): agree. I'll draft a tech-deep agenda for the product sync and collect the prompt/config examples they use. Sophie can we get a perf snapshot for 95p latency at their token sizes?
Sophie (CS Ops): will request traces from runtime team and export a sample trace. also grabbing anonymized request examples used last month.
Kyle (AE): I'll ask Claire for the pilot objectives and evaluation criteria on the procurement call. want to surface TCO concerns early.
Claire H. (Buyer): cc: procurement note here. primary questions: 1) pilot success criteria 2) latency at scale (95p) 3) commercial terms for short pilot 4) support levels. we'll be evaluating CompetitorX on cost and integration velocity.
Maria (CS Lead): thanks Claire. we'll prepare a one-pager comparing latency/SLA and draft a pilot plan with success metrics. Ajay, can you map their current flows to possible caching/quantization wins?
Ajay (CSM): yes—looks like many calls are repetitively hitting the same prompts; prefix caching could recover a chunk of tokens. I'll quantify expected savings for the pilot.
Eng Analytics Bot: exported request sample: https://s3.internal/ob/request-sample-2141599999.json. saved trend CSV: https://s3.internal/ob/usage-trend-2141599999.csv
Sophie (CS Ops): I'll bundle an enablement kit: playbook, onboarding checklist, suggested prompts, runbook for rollback, and a suggested 2-week re-engagement cadence.
Maria (CS Lead): owners recap: Kyle=procurement call & commercial negotiation, Ajay=product sync & savings estimate, Sophie=enablement + perf traces, Maria=pilot commercial offer & competitor one-pager. reconvene after procurement call to decide discount vs credits vs case study.
OpsBot: Reminder: renewal window opens in 38 days for OrchidBank (renewal_date=2141633799).
Kyle (AE): sending calendar invite to Claire + internal invites now.
Ajay (CSM): I'll prepare the draft agenda and post it in this thread before EOD.
Sophie (CS Ops): created tracker item: https://tasks.internal/CS/2141599999 (account-risk:amber). will update with traces once available.
Maria (CS Lead): thanks team. priority is to buy time and re-establish product confidence; this could flip to expansion if we solve cost issues.
OpsBot: thread archived by OpsBot.
